subject: Whoa J&As — Oct 21: CBP sole-sources legal reviewers for body-camera footage in 'unusual urgency' litigation surge
body:
## 1. CBP sole-sources legal reviewers for body-camera footage in 'unusual urgency' litigation surge

**US CUSTOMS AND BORDER PROTECTION (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Contact Government Services, LLC (CGS) · GSAR 538.7104-3(b)(1)(i)**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, award 70B04C26F00001107, “Legal Staffing Support and eDiscovery Services”*

CBP cites unusual urgency to place an order with Contact Government Services for document review in litigation over its enforcement operations. The document says an unanticipated rise in discovery and litigation demands has strained its Office of Chief Counsel.

> “CBP has experienced an unanticipated and unexpected rise in discovery and litigation demands that have strained OCC’s resources and ability to meet operational demands in a timely”  
> — SSJ_Legal_Staffing_Final_Redacted.pdf, p. 2

> “litigation challenging CBP’s operational implementation of the Secure America Act’s directives and ability to execute the White House’s priorities.”  
> — SSJ_Legal_Staffing_Final_Redacted.pdf, p. 1

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/f276ee9684e447dfb175747512c6f568/view) · [SSJ_Legal_Staffing_Final_Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/f276ee9684e447dfb175747512c6f568/9d03811abcad4f25bf6dcf41a2921b4a_SSJ_Legal_Staffing_Final_Redacted.pdf)

## 2. ICE extends sole-source detainee medical claims contract after VA 'abruptly terminated' support

**US IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Acentra Health, LLC (Acentra) · 41 U.S.C. §3304 as implemented by RFO 6.103-1**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, award 70CDCR26C00000002, “Medical Claims Support Extension”*

ICE says the VA ended claims processing for detained people's medical care on October 3, 2025, creating an emergency. It now plans to add six more option periods to the Acentra Health contract that was issued directly.

> “was abruptly terminated by the VA on October 3, 2025. This termination created an emergency because it compromised ICE's ability to provide medical care”  
> — 5.1.1-P00005_JOFOC_Claims_Redacted.pdf, p. 2 (machine-transcribed page)

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/e25509e392e44676bfe14bff8e4399cd/view) · [5.1.1-P00005_JOFOC_Claims_Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/e25509e392e44676bfe14bff8e4399cd/e3ac2d517409448b9e5ec8aaabf1b1bb_5.1.1-P00005_JOFOC_Claims_Redacted.pdf)

## 3. Joint Staff training bridge needed because new executive order requires approval of non-FFP contracts

**DEPT OF THE NAVY (DEPT OF DEFENSE) · Serco, Inc · 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1)-(2) as implemented by FAR 6.103-1 and FAR 6.103-2**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, award N0018926CD020, “Collective Joint Training Bridge Contract”*

The Navy is awarding a sole-source bridge to Serco because the incumbent burned labor hours faster than expected and funding ran out. The follow-on award awaits Assistant Secretary approval under a new rule implementing EO 14402.

> “the contractor has been utilizing level of effort hours at a faster rate than anticipated and funding constraints have only allowed the current task order to be funded until 29 September”  
> — Collective Joint Training Bridge JA Redacted.pdf, p. 1

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/1c2c3295991443d9a8e3c8c9eb274750/view) · [Collective Joint Training Bridge JA Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/1c2c3295991443d9a8e3c8c9eb274750/e702c4eb7545414cbf6e3c1dc9f16d6a_Collective_Joint_Training_Bridge_JA_Redacted.pdf)

## 4. ICE/HSI plans Pen-Link wiretap analysis software with embedded generative AI assistant

**US IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Pen-Link, Limited · RFO 6.103-1**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, “Notice of Intent to Sole Source - Telecommunications Analysis Software Support”*

HSI intends a sole-source award to Pen-Link for telecom analysis covering live intercepts, GPS tracking and geofence alerts. Requirements include an embedded generative AI assistant using ICE-provided Azure accounts.

> “An embedded Generative AI assistant (leveraging ICE/HSI-provided Azure AI accounts) enabling users to search, query, filter, interact with, summarize, map, and visualize”  
> — 1.2.1-NOI High Level Requirements 10.14.2026.pdf, p. 4

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/37a5b7df3e7b42bfb41b04372277738f/view) · [1.2.1-NOI High Level Requirements 10.14.2026.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/37a5b7df3e7b42bfb41b04372277738f/8531508496cd4664a6f2f8c539eb06f1_1.2.1-NOI_High_Level_Requirements_10.14.2026.pdf)

## 5. ICE buys Hootsuite social-media platform with AI and visual recognition, sole source

**US IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Carahsoft Technology Corp. · RFO 8.401(b) and GSAR 538.7104-4**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, award 70RTAC26A00000011, “Social Media Management Support Services”*

ICE's public affairs office is sole-sourcing Hootsuite through Carahsoft. The justification cites proprietary AI trained on social media data and image and video recognition.

> “Proprietary AI capability unavailable from other sources.”  
> — 1.5.1-BNJ_Redacted.pdf, p. 2

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/fe04a0d694db45a4a4611cbd9f5a09f1/view) · [1.5.1-BNJ_Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/fe04a0d694db45a4a4611cbd9f5a09f1/1fe83ebae23940f08b19efb918d71953_1.5.1-BNJ_Redacted.pdf)
